title: Exact cost of influence selection
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $t$ be a positive rational number, and let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. For any Boolean target function and any outcome in the support of the influence-selection program with parameters $n,t,\varepsilon$, the cost is exactly $\bigl(nm,\,0,\,nm+nm(n+1)+n\bigr)$, where $m$ is the program's singleton-influence sample count for these parameters.
hypotheses_covered: the target is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
the outcome belongs to the support of the specified program's run-with-cost distribution
